title: Before 2018, No Video Had Ever Reached 5 Billion YouTube Views

scenes.text: Before 2018, no YouTube video had reached five billion views.
Then Despacito did it on April 4, 2018, about 15 months after its upload.
That's an average of roughly 11 million views a day.
Guinness World Records also listed it as the most viewed video online.
It spent 16 straight weeks at number one in the United States.
Eleven million views a day, every day, for 15 months.

description:
Before 2018, no YouTube video had reached five billion views.
Luis Fonsi and Daddy Yankee's Despacito, uploaded January 12, 2017, became the first to hit five billion on April 4, 2018, averaging roughly 11 million views per day.
How many times have you watched it? Comment below.
first_comment: Do you remember where you were when Despacito took over? Tell us.
